inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): A follow-up inspection was conducted and compliance was not  met. One staff's file lacked a notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: A follow-up inspection was conducted and compliance was not met. One child's file lacked a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One child was missing emergency medical authorization in  their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: Three staff files did not have a high school diploma.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): Four staff files did not have a notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two children were missing emergency contact information in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Release of Children: The operational policies did not include procedures for the release of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Release of Children (26 TAC §746.501(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: Upon arrival at 11:25AM, no one was able to answer the door and allowed CCR entry until the director arrived at 12:20PM. No qualified caregiver was left in charge are able to answer the door without supervision concerns.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: Three children were missing release information in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §746.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): One staff file was missing Form 2912-Pre-employment affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: Substitutions for lunch were not made when the children ate cheese pizza but the weekly menu stated mac and cheese. This was corrected when the substitution was added.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions (26 TAC §746.3313(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect: The operational policies did not include all the required information for abuse and neglect.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect (26 TAC §746.501(a)(26))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Four children were missing a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger: The operational policies did not include the procedures of safe sleep for infants.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger (26 TAC §746.501(a)(9))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: It was found that a 4 year old in the infant area was placed in a high chair for time out. This was corrected when the 4 year old was taken out of the high chair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the walkthrough of the facility, it was found that the infant area did not have a caregiver leaving 4 children unattended from ages 7 months to 4 years old when the person in charge revealed that they were also the infant caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: It was found that a 7 month old infant was asleep in a bouncer. This was corrected when the infant was removed from the bouncer and placed in a crib to sleep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Authority: It was found that the caregiver in charge did not have the proper authority and resources to direct the center in compliance with minimum standards due to the caregiver not being able to adequately maintain supervision, ratio, and caregiver responsibilities in the in the infant room and assist with director responsibilities and inspection needs at the same time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Authority (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: In the toddler area, the caregiver did not have documentation showing each child's age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: In the infant area, a 4 year old and a 3 year old were combined with infants when the youngest infant was 7 months old and there was a total of 15 children in care. This was corrected when the 3 and 4 year old were removed from the infant area and placed in the toddler and pre-k rooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: Emergency drills were not made available for review when the caregiver in charge could not fulfill director duties and maintain proper supervision and ratio of the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: Playground maintenance records were not made available for review when the caregiver in charge could not fulfill director duties and maintain proper supervision and ratio of the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: Infant cribs were not labeled for two infants in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: No activity plans were posted in the infant, toddler, pre-k, and school age rooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area: The infant area did not have a handwashing sink in the diaper changing area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area (26 TAC §746.4403(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions: Infant feeding instructions were not made available to review when the caregiver in charge could not fulfill director duties and maintain proper supervision of the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §746.801(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: It was found that infant bottles were not properly labeled and did not include first name or last initial. This was corrected whent the first name and last initials were added to each bottle by the caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: Two infants were observed in the nap area, who was left unsupervised while the staff open the door for Licensing staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: The television in the Toddler classroom was mounted above the changing the table in the Toddler classroom. The cord from the television was hanging along the changing table, which poses as a risk to the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over (26 TAC §746.3701(10))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Mold was observed in the ceiling tiles in the Toddler classroom. There was chipped paint observed in the Preschool area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The information for indoor and outdoor physcial activities was not included in the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Adult-sized Chair: There was no rocking chair in the older infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Adult-sized Chair (26 TAC §746.2405(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: The information on supportive inclusive services was not included in the operatonal policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Operational Policies - Inform Parents Areas Within 1000 feet of Center is a Gang Free Zone: The gang free zone information was not included in the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Operational Policies - Inform Parents Areas Within 1000 feet of Center is a Gang Free Zone (26 TAC §746.501(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The fire inspection report reviewed was not complete prior to the application inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The sanitation (health) inspection reviewed expired on 10/8/25. In addition, the inspection report reviewed was not the correct type of inspection required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The Parent Rights information was not included in the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Breastfeeding Provisions: The information for allowing breastfeeding was not included in the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Breastfeeding Provisions (26 TAC §746.501(a)(25))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Vision and Hearing Screening: The vison and hearing screening information was not included in the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.501(a)(12))
